scenarios.title: The first resolution of a spell with paradigm exiles the spell instead of putting it into the graveyard
decisions: A casts Germination Practicum, tapping five Forests.
B passes without responding. Both players pass; Germination Practicum resolves.

variants.label: first_resolution
variants.expected: Germination Practicum resolves: Grizzly Bears gets two +1/+1 counters (4/4). Germination Practicum is exiled rather than put into the graveyard, and a paradigm effect for A is created that acts at the beginning of each of A's precombat main phases.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: In response, B casts Counterspell, tapping two Islands, targeting Germination Practicum.
variants.expected: Germination Practicum is countered and put into A's graveyard. It never resolves, so Grizzly Bears gets no counters (2/2) and no paradigm effect is created.

variants.label: second_resolution
variants.delta: A spell named Germination Practicum has already resolved earlier this game: another copy is in A's exile zone and its paradigm effect is active.
variants.expected: Germination Practicum resolves: Grizzly Bears gets two +1/+1 counters (4/4) and this Germination Practicum is exiled. It does not create a second paradigm effect, so A still gets one free copy per precombat main phase.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements paradigm as an exile sub-ability plus a Unique$ effect with a Main1 phase trigger. It may not check explicitly that this is the first resolution.

scenarios.title: At the beginning of each of its controller's precombat main phases a copy of the paradigm spell may be cast free from exile

setup.notes: A resolved Germination Practicum earlier in the game; it was exiled and its paradigm effect is active. The step named is the beginning of that phase.

decisions: The precombat main phase of A begins; the paradigm trigger goes on the stack.
A chooses to cast a copy of Germination Practicum from exile without paying its mana cost.
Both players pass; the copy resolves.

variants.label: own_precombat_main
variants.expected: The paradigm trigger fires and a copy is created in exile and cast. Grizzly Bears gets two +1/+1 counters (4/4). The copy ceases to exist and the original Germination Practicum stays in exile.

variants.label: own_postcombat_main
variants.delta: The step is A's postcombat main phase (main2), not the precombat one.
variants.expected: No paradigm trigger fires. Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.

variants.label: opponents_precombat_main
variants.delta: B is the active player at the beginning of B's precombat main phase.
variants.expected: No paradigm trigger fires, as the effect acts only in its controller's main phases. Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.
